finding: KSU's note 9 for Tabari 108:3 attributes the ṣunbūr gloss to Lisān al-ʿArab. A directly readable Lisān al-ʿArab entry, حرف الصاد / صنبر, part 8, contains the same sequence: ṣunbūr as a palm frond growing in a palm trunk rather than soil; Abu ʿUbayda's explanation of the solitary palm and its thin/stripped lower trunk; and the Quraysh taunt interpreted as ending the Prophet's remembrance/lineage. The live Arabic row 5263 also contains that note. This supports the named lexical attribution at the level of text content; it does not identify the exact print edition behind KSU or map legacy source ID 310.
